name: Liberty XL-2
summary: Sleek certified two-seat trainer and tourer from Florida, derived from the Europa XS kit plane. Composite fuselage, aluminum wing and FADEC engine.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
Rectangular, untapered wing with large Fowler flaps
engines: Single Continental IOF-240 flat-four with FADEC, in a smooth cowl
fuselage: Slim composite fuselage with a big, bubble-like windscreen
Fixed tricycle gear on slim sprung-steel legs
tail: Conventional fin and rudder with a low horizontal tail

tellTales: Sleek two-seat low-wing with a large, bubble-like windscreen
Rectangular, untapered wing with big flaps
Tricycle gear on three slim sprung-steel legs

confusedWith.howToTell: The DA20 has a T-tail; the XL-2 has a conventional low horizontal tail.
The Alarus is a blunt-nosed all-metal two-seater; the XL-2 is slimmer with a composite fuselage and a big, bubble-like windscreen.
The Tomahawk has a T-tail and a rounded greenhouse cabin; the XL-2 has a conventional tail and a more tapered fuselage.
